name: JavaScript - Loops & Arrays
description: Learn about loops and working with multiple data items

rules.hint: Declare an array: let fruits = ["apple", "banana", "orange"]; Arrays store multiple values in one variable.

rules.text: Create an unordered list in HTML to display the array
rules.hint: Add: <ul id="fruitList"></ul>. We'll use JavaScript to fill this list with array items.

rules.text: Use a for loop to display each array item
rules.hint: Loop through array: for (let i = 0; i < fruits.length; i++) { document.getElementById("fruitList").innerHTML += "<li>" + fruits[i] + "</li>"; } Loops repeat code.

completion.message: 🎉 Fantastic! You can now work with arrays and loops!
